verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is fundamentally built around GGUF-format models, with CLI/server commands directly loading GGUF repos (e.g., `-hf ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF`), extensive quantization support (1.5-8 bit), and community evidence confirms real-world loading and running of GGUF quantized models across CPU/GPU/Apple Silicon.
